CV_Q63: A Place to Wait for Home
CV_WAIT: Wait for the other person to signal
CV_LOCKED: Hear the town’s next request first
CV_RESET_ASK: A again: reset this local attempt
CV_RESET_DONE: This place is ready for another attempt
CV_INVITED: One companion chose to travel with you
CV_FULFILLED: Work fulfilled. An invitation is your choice
CV_READY: Report the work to the town
CV_FULL: The roster has no admission space
CV_RESERVED: Keep the reserved spaces for later companions
CV_ID_LIMIT: A new identity cannot be recorded
CV_FIT: Look again at the open gap
CV_WRONG: Choose the power that fits this mark

CV_TRACE: The visible power reached this work
CV_REST: Rested and recorded a return point
CV_INVITE_LATER: Invite later at this named place
CV_DECLINED: The work remains done. You may invite later
CV_PRACTICE: A: practice with the completed work
CV_PRACTICE_DONE: The inner way is briefly easier
CV_PRACTICE_NEED: Fulfill this covenant and invite its companion

CV_RELEASE: Press R while that same cast holds warmth

CV_CLUE60A: Ask the original elder about the porch.
CV_CLUE60B: Read the fair’s household letter; take its northeast path.
CV_CLUE61A: Begin four covenants from Siltwake Steps.
CV_CLUE61B: Finishing the work and inviting a companion are separate.
CV_CLUE62A: From Hollowbell Court, visit the next four places.
CV_CLUE62B: Leave an opening wide enough for a person.
CV_CLUE63A: Choose the porch’s purpose, then meet the group at the fair.
CV_CLUE63B: Walk the fair together, then return to the original elder.
CV_HOME_A: Traveler: I would like a quiet porch of my own.
CV_HOME_B: Elder: You are making somewhere to come home to.
CV_LETTER_A: The crafts arrive. Families are still waiting.
CV_LETTER_B: A footpath has opened northeast of the fair.
CV_WELCOME_A: Share the water and you notice who is waiting.
CV_WELCOME_B: Help with five small jobs, one settled station at a time.
CV_LOWER_REPORT_A: The lower circuit has learned to share the work.
CV_LOWER_REPORT_B: People are waiting at the court to the north as well.
CV_UPPER_REPORT_A: Four places now have people ready to carry the work.
CV_UPPER_REPORT_B: Now let us think about your own road home.
CV_PORCH_A: I could make my porch a waiting place for people coming home.
CV_PORCH_B: I would also give time to meet them, even when I want to rest.
CV_PORCH_ASK_A: This gives up the porch’s private quiet. Is that your choice?
CV_PORCH_ASK_B: A: share it. B: leave this promise open for now.
CV_PORCH_YES_A: There will be a seat for the next person too.
CV_PORCH_YES_B: First meet the returning group at the fair’s northeast entry.
CV_FAIR_RETURN_A: Let us walk at a pace everyone chooses.
CV_FAIR_RETURN_B: We can rest together at the far side of the fair.
CV_HOME_RETURN_A: Elder: We have been waiting to hear you say you are home.
CV_HOME_RETURN_B: The small porch now carries marks from the other communities.
CV_END_A: A place for the people returning and the people who wait.
CV_END_B: Each companion has chosen its own way.
CV_END_INVITED_A: Those who chose to travel are here with you.
CV_END_INVITED_B: When you are ready, travel together at a pace you share.
CV_END_WAITING_A: Those who stayed have homes and work they chose.
CV_END_WAITING_B: The promises are fulfilled even without an invitation.
CV_TRIAL1A: Work the five signs around the dry bank.
CV_TRIAL1B: After a station settles, you may change companions.
CV_TRIAL2A: The younger bed needs a share of the shade.
CV_TRIAL2B: Watch the open light patch before pulling the roof.
CV_TRIAL3A: Gather warmth at the plate; release it into the seam.
CV_TRIAL3B: Leave the exhaust open and watch the bright rim fade.
CV_TRIAL4A: The near weight changes when the traveler moves.
CV_TRIAL4B: Use the side gallery and wait for their next step.
CV_TRIAL5A: Let the court be heard and the resting room stay quiet.
CV_TRIAL5B: Watch where the pale sound wedges end.
CV_TRIAL6A: Overlap shade across both seed beds.
CV_TRIAL6B: Keep a person-sized opening for walking and light.
CV_TRIAL7A: Read the landing marks on both shores first.
CV_TRIAL7B: The final rope belongs to the person waiting there.
CV_TRIAL8A: Leave the mouth open; warm the seam and brace the wall.
CV_TRIAL8B: Take one squall at a time, then pass the watch.
CV_AFTER1A: Water reaches both branches; the dry walking banks remain.
CV_AFTER1B: The residents decide their own waiting order.
CV_AFTER2A: Old grafts and young saplings both have shade.
CV_AFTER2B: Two growers look up together at their bent roof.
CV_AFTER3A: The repaired household bowls take the best shelf.
CV_AFTER3B: The exhibition plaque has a place beside them.
CV_AFTER4A: The traveler crossed at their own pace.
CV_AFTER4B: The person tending the weights can follow safely.
CV_AFTER5A: The court keeps its sound; the alcove keeps its quiet.
CV_AFTER5B: A modest promise has made room for both.
CV_AFTER6A: The seed labels name several contributing communities.
CV_AFTER6B: The keeper’s walking path stays open.
CV_AFTER7A: Two people meet; the ferry rests at its landing.
CV_AFTER7B: A slower shared timetable is hung on the wall.
CV_AFTER8B: The traveler does not have to disappear to keep the road safe.
CV_INVITE1A: The town can choose where its water goes.
CV_INVITE2A: The younger branches are cared for here now.
CV_INVITE3A: The keeper has learned to let the kiln cool.
CV_INVITE4A: The people crossing can choose their own pace.
CV_INVITE5A: The court has learned how to share its sound.
CV_INVITE6A: The next keeper can also tend these seedlings.
CV_INVITE7A: People on both banks are ready to wait for each other.
CV_INVITE8A: No one has to bear every watch alone.
CV_STEWARD_A: Steward: Making water run faster would have been easy.
CV_STEWARD_B: I had forgotten to count the people waiting.
CV_GROWER_A: Grower: My grandmother joined the older grafts.
CV_GROWER_B: I want the young saplings to have shade too.
CV_KILN_KEEPER_A: Kiln keeper: Today I am mending everyday bowls before prize pieces.
CV_KILN_KEEPER_B: A hurried seam would only crack again.
CV_WALKER_A: Traveler: Watch my signal before you watch my load.
CV_WALKER_B: I will tell you when I am ready to cross.
CV_REPAIRER_A: Repairer: I wanted to be known for a louder bell.
CV_REPAIRER_B: My neighbor asked me for a smaller promise.
CV_SEED_KEEPER_A: Seed keeper: These seeds were lent to me.
CV_SEED_KEEPER_B: The labels should carry the names of the places that sent them.
CV_FERRY_KEEPER_A: Ferry keeper: A faster boat cannot make someone ready to receive it.
CV_FERRY_KEEPER_B: Let the other shore decide its own signal.
CV_WATCHER_A: Watcher: If you keep every watch, we never learn to take our turn.
CV_WATCHER_B: My turn next. You have somewhere to go home to as well.
CV_CHOOSE_POWER: Select the signature command on the Growth page
CV_PARTY_ONE: One legendary companion in the active party.
